description: Right To Play is a celebration and a call to action to fight for our Right To Play. With bamboo den and structure building, Puppetry interaction, a "Long Table Mud Kitchen" play and a Run, Jump, Swing sculpture.

factsheet.heading: Pif-Paf Theatre: Right To Play
paragraphs:
Right To Play is a collaborative self-built play world with Den Building, balance, swing and jump play and a "Long Table Mud Kitchen" - families of all ages can find a way to play, make new friends and explore the new worlds you make.
Come and stay as long as you like between 12pm and 5pm - jump into our stock of materials, build, explore, play - start again!
...And keep an eye out for the tiny puppets.

factsheet.heading: Who are Pif-Paf Theatre?
paragraphs: A highly acclaimed visual and physical theatre company, Pif-Paf creates stunning and constantly evolving work from the intimate to the extreme. Since 2005 they have taken audiences on a roller-coaster ride through a land of giant puppets, natural history, mobile theatre and high adrenaline circus.

factsheet.heading: Build / Play / Shape Croydon
paragraphs:
This activity is part of Build / Play / Shape Croydon.
Launch into a weekend of design-inspired creativity and play for all ages, 12-13 September.
